description: 【和歌山県】高野・熊野エリアと白浜エリアの路線バス情報のオープンデータ「標準的なバス情報フォーマット(GTFS-JP)」 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 和歌山県. 熊野地域及びその周辺地域（高野地域、白浜地域）を含むバス情報のデータを「標準的なバス情報フォーマット（GTFS-JP）」の形式で整理を行いました。 これにより、Google Maps等の経路検索サイトへのデータ提供が促進されるほか、新たなサービスの創出にも寄与することを期待するものです。 なお、「GTFS-JP」(General Tran... Coverage: 和歌山県. The portal files it under the publisher 和歌山県. Its tags are 公共交通, 観光, 運輸. It offers 4 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2024-03-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
